name: legion-observability
description: See everything Legion does and close the self-learning loop. Unified legion.span.v1 telemetry, `legion-report` cost/success/latency, `legion-bench` deterministic repeated gates, `legion-self-learn` evidence/proposals, review-only `legion-improve` draft PRs, `legion-trace`, `legion-otel-export`, and `legion-doctor` verification.
